objective: Take up PATH-HYBRID-20261108-001's direction 1, relayed by the coordinator on 2026-11-08 (G5 with G1). Search families of four-ring paths parametrised by size, each ring's linear rule and each contact law fixed while all four rings grow together (the middle rings' contacts antipodal, or two apart), for a family native at every size from 3 to 9 cells per ring; also paths that grow longer, ring by ring. Characterise any survivor, or the evidence that binding at every lag is tied to particular sizes, which would put A34 under challenge. status: Complete 2026-11-08: no family of paths with one linear rule per ring is native at every size (with all four rings of 3, 4 or 5 cells none is native at all; the longer families fail at five rings); growth breaks composition, not persistence; native paths sit at isolated shapes (3/5/5/3, 5/6/6/5, 4/7/7/5, and five with rule 150 on every ring), each family at one shape, none surviving one more cell. A34 put under challenge; two corrections logged; recommendation Research directions (challenge A34 with composition at recurring lags).
stop_rule: Stop with a family native at every size of its schedule (3 to 9 cells per ring, 4 to 9 with contacts two apart, or 4 to 9 rings), verified and characterised, or with every family failing by the largest size, recorded as evidence that binding at every lag is tied to particular sizes, which puts A34 under challenge.
title: Native paths that survive growth
